newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures end higher, led by June marks.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures end higher, led by June marks.

text.p: April 21 - IMM currency futures finished higher, led by mark strength amid light to moderate volume. Traders eye Chirac's call for early Parliamentary election in France, said dollar bulls wary heading into G7 next weekend. One trading floor manager said mark bullishness began overnight, with technical followthrough extending gains in day session.
